lanes.current_read: Automatic non-v10 source-supported waves are promising but still need broader held-out proof and phrase-contract coverage before runtime-quality claims. The wave5 materialized portfolio passes source admission with 51 final admitted rows, 0 leakage rejects, 0 sense rejects, and semantic contract coverage 16 / 16. The former active/shadow blocker `present:002` is now treated as a same-visible-target active case because the source portfolio already contains the current-time noun sense for visible replacement `presente`. A WordNet phrase-control miner adds 7 containment-only rows across 7 / 16 phrase cases, including `end tables placed conveniently` for the former `end:001` no-winner blocker. With that phrase-expanded evidence batch, the frozen wave5 active/shadow and phrase/no-winner held-out suites now both pass at 0 harmful replacements / 0 false abstains. The next breadth screen excluded 43 already-studied triggers and still found 100 candidates. On that fresh list, the supported-source wave6 sweep reaches only 6 / 16 admission-selected families, while the paired forward-only upper-bound sweep reaches 55 / 64 semantic coverage and a 16 / 16 selected control wave. The first conversion audit showed 0 / 16 selected upper-bound families fully supported and only 13 / 38 selected senses already supported. The Wiktextract translation-table overlay converts that gap: translation-sense evidence has 38 rows, covers 38 / 38 selected senses and 16 / 16 families, and passes leakage/sense admission. Alternate WordNet sense phrase evidence adds 180 admitted phrase-control rows and gives every wave6 family phrase coverage. The phrase-prototype semantic guard protects the 16-row phrase suite at 0 harmful, but over-abstains active cases. Independent phrase-prototype margin sweeping is useful but not sufficient: the best zero-harm active/shadow point is margin 0 / phrase margin 0.02 with 0 harmful, 7 false abstains, 56.2% recall, and 81.6% accuracy; higher phrase margins recover some active cases but leak harmful phrase/no-winner replacements. The hybrid phrase-prototype plus surface-POS guard is the strongest current wave6 signal on active/shadow, reaching 0 harmful, 2 false abstains, 87.5% recall, and 94.7% accuracy, but it is not promotable because the phrase/no-winner suite regresses to 2 harmful replacements (`low` rating and `bear` animal). A replay-only rescue-gating sweep over the fixed hybrid traces found no passing policy: phrase/no-winner can be restored to 0 harmful / 0 false abstains, but every tested rescue gate leaves at least the active/shadow `leave` permission-vs-absence and dark `black` false abstains. The surface-POS margin sweep now replays fixed scorer traces for both phrase-prototype and surface-POS shapes, making context-view sweeps practical. In that context sweep, `raw_sentence` and `raw_window` recover dark `black` at margin 0 / phrase margin 0.02; raw-sentence held-out validation reaches 0 harmful, 1 false abstain, 93.8% recall, and 97.4% accuracy on active/shadow. A deterministic authorization-frame adapter then addresses `leave` through source-backed semantic class evidence, not a word-specific row: it emits 5 generic manager-free authorization rows only when gloss/translation-sense text is permission-like. Those rows pass leakage and sense admission, and the raw-sentence active/shadow lane reaches 0 harmful, 0 false abstains, 100% recall, and 100% accuracy across 38 cases. The unrescued phrase/no-winner lane is unchanged at 2 harmful replacements, but the auth-frame raw-sentence rescue sweep now finds 12 passing policies across active/shadow plus phrase/no-winner suites, with recommended policy margin 0 / phrase margin 0.02 / rescue active floor 0.52 / modifier phrase-lead ceiling 0.02. Failure-class mining still marks broad promotion as review because the tested breadth is only 16 families and 54 heldout cases.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote yet. Preserve wave5 as a seed-pass lane and keep wave6 as the active research target. Treat authorization frames plus rescue replay as the strongest current wave6 candidate, then broaden breadth before runtime claims: add more source-backed semantic-class adapters only when the class can be detected from source data, generate locked heldout families for those classes, and run admission, active/shadow heldout, phrase/no-winner heldout, rescue sweeps, failure mining, and the rulegen quality loop before any production-policy change.

lanes.current_read: The source-row loader and context selector exist, and the source-frame gap plan has now been executed under spend caps. The first live aligned-frame run generated 97 rows; strict leakage/duplicate and sense admission kept 36. Merged into the prior 87-row source control, the frozen source-admission ablation improved to 0 harmful / 1 false abstain, but active/shadow held-out v2 still had 1 false abstain. A prompt-process fix added aligned-sentence-frame-v2 diversity frames; the follow-up 5-row board-shadow micro-run admitted 3 rows and made all 19 active/shadow families selector-ready. The source-scope margin bakeoff then showed a stronger way to use source rows: add them to the incumbent definition/example row surface. Combined LLM-v2 plus WordNet-reference additive rows reached 0 harmful / 37 false abstains across four suites, versus 0 / 44 for the no-source row control.
lanes.next_action: Do not promote yet. Treat additive source evidence as the leading research candidate and test companion negative controls, broader heldout, source-family agreement, calibrated aggregation, and additive context selection before a runtime-policy claim.

lanes.current_read: The first deterministic semantic-class adapter emits generic English authorization frames only when a selected sense's source-backed gloss or translation-sense text is permission-like. It now uses manager-free templates to reduce heldout lexical overlap. The 5-row candidate passes leakage and sense admission; merged with the wave6 alternate-phrase batch it moves raw-sentence active/shadow validation from 0 harmful / 1 false abstain to 0 harmful / 0 false abstains on 38 cases. Phrase/no-winner behavior is unchanged before rescue, which is expected for a source adapter that only targets authorization evidence.
lanes.next_action: Keep this as a mechanism lane, not a runtime claim. Add class-frame adapters only when a source-backed semantic class is detectable without browser-sentence text, then test each through admission, active/shadow heldout, phrase/no-winner heldout, rescue sweeps, and breadth mining.

The no-source row control was 0 / 44; source-heldout v2 improved from 0 / 17 to 0 / 12. The cell trace shows this is source representation progress: LLM-v2 lacked red-blood-cell active evidence, while the existing WordNet-reference lane supplied it.
lanes.next_action: Do not change production policy yet. Run companion negative controls and broader held-out validation for the additive surface, then test source-family agreement, calibrated row weighting, and additive context-selected variants against this candidate.

lanes.current_read: The first context-conditioned sweep loaded 87 admitted source rows and did not beat the separate-row max control: best source-plus-definition selectors over-abstained at 53 false abstains and pure source-row selectors at 55. After live aligned-frame generation plus strict admission, the v2 selector-ready composite has 126 rows and all 19 active/shadow families are selector-ready. The best source-plus-definition selector improved to 0 harmful / 47 false abstains, while pure source-row selectors are 0 / 48. A later source-scope bakeoff showed the stronger current surface is additive source evidence over the row-level control, not context selection by itself.
lanes.next_action: Keep the selector machinery as research infrastructure, but do not promote it. Re-test context selection only after additive source evidence, source-family agreement, or calibrated row aggregation has a stronger row surface to select from.

methodology_rules: Do not use a generic done state.
Do not mark a lane swept without a reproducible manifest or generated artifact.
Do not mark a lane promotable from discovery data alone.
Do not collapse source-coverage work, score-surface work, final decision-rule work, and phrase/no-winner work into one metric.
Keep negative controls visible for every candidate family.
Keep phrase/no-winner behavior visible separately from active-vs-shadow scoring.
Record whether the lane changes c, a, similarity, aggregation, final decision, source coverage, phrase handling, or runtime policy.
Production runtime policy remains unchanged until a candidate beats the incumbent on frozen and held-out suites.
